# Pts 1.0.0 compatibility fixtures

These unchanged demos and image assets are from the Pts 1.0.0 release commit
`034e5f6ac8bcf54d2121ef88799ac43fc4b2c827` in
https://github.com/williamngan/pts. The accompanying LICENSE is from that source.

`compatibility/pts-revamp.json` records every demo and asset SHA-256 digest.
The verifier runs these fixtures against the installed npm Pts package, without
fetching or modifying an upstream checkout. Source changes require an explicit
review and manifest update. These test fixtures are not shipped in pts-render.
